title:
Our annual Trustee 'Thank You' meal (and combined board meeting).  Thank you to all our Trustees for your expert guidance and safe governance of our Charity.  This is a small thank you for your year-round commitment and generosity. 

If you have specialist skills in social housing, mental health, adult social care, fundraising or governance, we'd love to hear from you. 

#trustee #trusteerecruitment
